title: "Movie Analysis"
author: "Isabella Chandler"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ")
```

```{r}
movies |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Rotten Tomatoes Critic Scores",
    subtitle = "Across 29,783 films",
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |>
  filter(tomatoMeter != 0, audienceScore != 0) |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  summarize(
    mean_gap = mean(gap),
    n = n(),
    .by = genre
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)
```

```{r}
movies_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_gap, y = fct_reorder(genre, mean_gap))) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Critic vs. Audience Score Gap by Movie Genre",
    subtitle = "Positive values mean critics rate higher; negative values mean audiences rate higher",
    x = "Average Gap (Tomatometer − Audience Score)",
    y = "Genre"
  )
```

```{r}
spiderman <- movies |>
  filter(
    title %in% c(
      "Spider-Man",
      "Spider-Man 2",
      "Spider-Man 3",
      "The Amazing Spider-Man",
      "The Amazing Spider-Man 2",
      "Spider-Man: Homecoming",
      "Spider-Man: Far From Home",
      "Spider-Man: No Way Home"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    actor = case_when(
      str_detect(title, "Amazing") ~ "Andrew Garfield",
      str_detect(title, ":") ~ "Tom Holland",
      .default = "Tobey Maguire"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(releaseDateTheaters)

spiderman |>
  mutate(title = fct_inorder(title)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(tomatoMeter, audienceScore),
    names_to = "score_type",
    values_to = "score"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = title, y = score, color = score_type, group = score_type)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_discrete(
    labels = c(audienceScore = "Audience Score", tomatoMeter = "Tomatometer")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 30)) +
  labs(
    title = "Critics Rated Early Spider-Man Films Higher, Then Audiences Caught Up",
    x = "Film (in Release Order)",
    y = "Score",
    color = "Rating Source"
  )
```
